title: Quantifying Risk Propensities of Large Language Models: Ethical Focus and Bias Detection through Role-Play
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. Its focus is on quantifying risk propensities and ethical decision-making, with bias detection centered on social groups defined by occupation, ethnicity, and education level.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study.
